title: Been working on a boxing game recently
author: opposhore
selftext:
I won't pretend I've been working on this for months, but I've put quite a bit of time into it recently to see if I could make something decent. I'd love some feedback on how it is and how it could be improved. I'm not planning to turn it into a full game, but I'd be open to it if someone with prior experience wanted to help.

  
Demo: [https://iron-gloves.pages.dev](https://iron-gloves.pages.dev)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/opposhore please share some more about how you used AI in developing this. Naming the tools or saying "made with AI" doesn't count. Rule 4 is how we keep promotional posts contributing, by having them talk about the process and how the game was made. Trying to keep the sub focused on dev. This post may be removed if it isn't updated.

comments.author: jakiestfu
comments.body: More fluid animations maybe! Also the crows is really disorienting for some reason. Maybe spending some more time in those areas could be beneficial!

comments.author: ChuyStyle
comments.body:
Great work man. What's your plan on foot work like slips and parties? 
Id say in pov perspective the gloves are a lot bigger.

Love the KO

replies.author: opposhore
replies.body: Thank you! Yeah animations still need a lot of tuning. This was the version I was kinda satisfied with, which is also why I've kept the gloves that way for now. I didn't have time to retune the animations after changing the pose
